item.title: U.S. law prohibiting a retail Federal Reserve digital token took effect July 10 after Trump let the bill become law unsigned.
U.S. Treasury released GENIUS Act stablecoin implementation rules in July; non-compliant issuers face market exit pressure by September.
Binance halted new spot orders, deposits and sign-ups for EU users on July 1 after withdrawing its MiCA license application in Greece.
MiCA enforcement fully active as of July 1; approximately 200 of an estimated 1,300 operators across the EU secured licenses.
SEC extended its deadline to Aug. 26 to rule on BlackRock's request to allow in-kind redemptions for its iShares Ethereum ETF (ETHA).
SEC and CFTC jointly classified Bitcoin, Ether, XRP, and Solana as digital commodities under CFTC jurisdiction in a March interpretation.
EU regulators moved in late July to ban crypto platforms operating from jurisdictions linked to Russian sanctions evasion.
CFTC approved KalshiEX to list the first U.S.-regulated Bitcoin perpetual futures contract in May, opening a path for onshore crypto perps.
Laser Digital received conditional U.S. national trust bank charter approval in May, as at least 15 digital asset firms seek charters.
Citi is preparing to launch crypto custody for institutional clients in 2026, allowing it to hold native bitcoin and other digital assets.
EU MiCA fines have exceeded EUR 540M since enforcement began; maximum penalties reach 12.5% of annual turnover for serious violations.
BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust holds 764,395 BTC worth approximately $45B, making it the world's largest Bitcoin ETF.
BlackRock's staked Ether ETF stakes 70-95% of holdings and distributes 82% of gross staking rewards monthly to investors.
Kelp DAO lost $293M in the largest DeFi exploit of 2026 on April 19 after attackers drained funds via a smart contract vulnerability.
Forty crypto hacks in June 2026 resulted in $75.87M in losses; Humanity Protocol suffered the largest single incident at over $30M.
